// Volatility Coil Release Model - Loaded vs Predictable 3D
// ATR: Wilder RMA — validated vs TradingView | Coil: percentile rank | Predict: efficiency ratio

atrLen = input(14, "ATR Length", 2, 60, 1)
coilLookback = input(100, "Coil Lookback", 20, 200, 1)
volVolLen = input(20, "Vol of Vol Length", 5, 60, 1)
predictLen = input(20, "Predictability Length", 5, 60, 1)
coilThresh = input(20.0, "Coil Threshold", 5.0, 40.0, 1.0)
releaseMult = input(1.5, "Release Multiplier", 1.1, 3.0, 0.1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

TR = max(high - low, abs(high - close[1]), abs(low - close[1]))
ATRval = atr(high, low, close, atrLen)
RangeVal = high - low
ATRhi = highest(ATRval, volVolLen)
ATRlo = lowest(ATRval, volVolLen)
VoV = (ATRhi - ATRlo) / max(ATRlo, 0.0000001)
VoVRising = VoV > VoV[1]
Direction = abs(close - close[predictLen])
Expansion = RangeVal > releaseMult * ATRval and ATRval > ATRval[1]
loadedThresh = 100 - coilThresh
predGate = 0.3

coilCount = 0
for i = 1 to coilLookback {
  if ATRval < ATRval[i] {
    coilCount := coilCount + 1
  }
}
CoilRank = 100 * coilCount / coilLookback
CoilLoad = CoilRank
loaded = CoilLoad > loadedThresh

noiseSum = 0.0
for j = 0 to predictLen - 1 {
  noiseSum := noiseSum + RangeVal[j]
}
Predict = Direction / max(noiseSum, 0.0000001)
predictable = Predict > predGate
predScaled = Predict * 100
vovScaled = VoV * 100

buySig = loaded and VoVRising and Expansion and close > open[predictLen]
sellSig = loaded and VoVRising and Expansion and close < open[predictLen]
buyPred = buySig and predictable
buyChop = buySig and not predictable
sellPred = sellSig and predictable
sellChop = sellSig and not predictable

if buySig { plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy Release", "triangleup", "#22cc88") }
if sellSig { plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell Release", "triangledown", "#ff4477") }
if buyPred { plotshape_3d(bar_index, predScaled, "Buy Pred", "coneup", "#22ff88", markerSize * 1.6, 1, "separate") }
if buyChop { plotshape_3d(bar_index, predScaled, "Buy Chop", "coneup", "#5a7aa5", markerSize * 0.7, 1, "separate") }
if sellPred { plotshape_3d(bar_index, predScaled, "Sell Pred", "conedown", "#ff4477", markerSize * 1.6, 1, "separate") }
if sellChop { plotshape_3d(bar_index, predScaled, "Sell Chop", "conedown", "#5a7aa5", markerSize * 0.7, 1, "separate") }

bgcolor(loaded ? "#1c3a5e" : "#131722")
plot(CoilLoad, "CoilLoad", "#22aaff", 2, "separate")
plot(Predict, "Predict", "#b48cff", 1, "separate")
plot(loadedThresh, "Loaded Line", "#ffd43b", 1, "separate")
plot3d(CoilLoad, "Coil Load", "ribbon", "#22aaff", "separate", 0)
plot3d(predScaled, "Predictability", "bars3d", "#b48cff", "separate", 1)
plot3d(vovScaled, "Expansion VoV", "scatter", "#ffd43b", "separate", 2)

// Multi-Timeframe Siege Model — session extremes + confirmed 1h structure + model.* execution
sessLen = input(20, "Session Length", 5, 100, 1)
confBars = input(2, "Structure Confirmation Bars", 1, 10, 1)
qualLook = input(5, "Structure Quality Lookback", 2, 20, 1)
hardStopOff = input(2, "Hard Stop Offset", 0, 50, 1)
minConf = input(60, "Min Confidence", 0, 100, 1)

sessHigh = highest(high, sessLen)
sessLow = lowest(low, sessLen)

htfClose = security("1h", close)
htfHigh = security("1h", high)
htfLow = security("1h", low)

priorHtfHigh = highest(htfHigh, qualLook)[1]
priorHtfLow = lowest(htfLow, qualLook)[1]
priorHtfRange = priorHtfHigh - priorHtfLow

bullRaw = htfClose > priorHtfHigh
bearRaw = htfClose < priorHtfLow

bullHold = 0.0
bearHold = 0.0
bullHold = bullRaw ? 1 : 0
bearHold = bearRaw ? 1 : 0
bullCount = 0.0
bearCount = 0.0
bullCount = 0
bearCount = 0
i = 0
i = 0
for i = 0 to 20 {
    if i < confBars {
        if htfClose[i] > priorHtfHigh[i] {
            bullCount = bullCount + 1
        }
        if htfClose[i] < priorHtfLow[i] {
            bearCount = bearCount + 1
        }
    }
}
bullAgree = bullCount >= confBars
bearAgree = bearCount >= confBars

bullDispRaw = priorHtfRange > 0 ? (htfClose - priorHtfHigh) / priorHtfRange * 100 : 0
bearDispRaw = priorHtfRange > 0 ? (priorHtfLow - htfClose) / priorHtfRange * 100 : 0
dispPick = bullRaw ? bullDispRaw : bearRaw ? bearDispRaw : 0
dispScore = dispPick < 0 ? 0 : dispPick > 50 ? 50 : dispPick

wickLow = lowest(htfLow, qualLook)
wickHigh = highest(htfHigh, qualLook)
cleanBull = wickLow > priorHtfHigh
cleanBear = wickHigh < priorHtfLow
cleanPick = bullRaw ? cleanBull : bearRaw ? cleanBear : 0
cleanBonus = cleanPick ? 25 : 0

chopCount = 0.0
chopCount = 0
j = 0
j = 0
for j = 0 to 20 {
    if j < qualLook {
        if j + 1 < qualLook + 1 {
            d0 = htfClose[j] - htfClose[j + 1]
            d1 = htfClose[j + 1] - htfClose[j + 2]
            if d0 > 0 and d1 < 0 {
                chopCount = chopCount + 1
            }
            if d0 < 0 and d1 > 0 {
                chopCount = chopCount + 1
            }
        }
    }
}
chopPenalty = chopCount * 5
confRaw = 25 + dispScore + cleanBonus - chopPenalty
confidence = confRaw < 0 ? 0 : confRaw > 100 ? 100 : confRaw

longStop = sessLow - hardStopOff
shortStop = sessHigh + hardStopOff

breakHigh = crossover(close, sessHigh[1])
breakLow = crossunder(close, sessLow[1])
alertSig = crossover(confidence, minConf) and (bullAgree or bearAgree) and (breakHigh or breakLow)

buySig = breakHigh and bullAgree and confidence >= minConf
sellSig = breakLow and bearAgree and confidence >= minConf

var inLong = 0.0
var inShort = 0.0
exitLongLevel = crossunder(close, sessHigh[1])
exitShortLevel = crossover(close, sessLow[1])
hitLongStop = low <= longStop
hitShortStop = high >= shortStop
exitLong = inLong == 1 and (exitLongLevel or hitLongStop)
exitShort = inShort == 1 and (exitShortLevel or hitShortStop)

if buySig {
    model.confidence(confidence / 100)
    model.stopLoss(hardStopOff)
    model.longEntry("siege-long")
    inLong := 1
    inShort := 0
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
}
if sellSig {
    model.confidence(confidence / 100)
    model.stopLoss(hardStopOff)
    model.shortEntry("siege-short")
    inShort := 1
    inLong := 0
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
}
if exitLong {
    model.longExit("siege-long")
    inLong := 0
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Exit", "diamond", "#ffcc00")
}
if exitShort {
    model.shortExit("siege-short")
    inShort := 0
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Exit", "diamond", "#ffcc00")
}

plot(sessHigh, "Session High", "#ff4477", 1, "stepline")
plot(sessLow, "Session Low", "#22cc88", 1, "stepline")
